# hpe_morpheus_security_group_rule (Data Source)



## Example Usage - Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_security_group_rule" "example" {
  name              = "default"
  security_group_id = 5
}
```

## Example Usage - Id

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_security_group_rule" "example" {
  id                = 1
  security_group_id = 5
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `security_group_id` (Number) The ID of the parent security group.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the security group rule.
- `name` (String) The name of the security group rule.
